chapter_title: A Tale of Valour: Major Somnath Sharma and the Battle of Badgam
executive_summary: On November 3, 1947, Major Somnath Sharma led D Company of the 4th Battalion, Kumaon Regiment at Badgam, defending Srinagar Airfield against 500 tribal raiders. Despite an arm in a plaster cast, he personally refilled ammunition and directed defense until killed by a mortar shell. His heroism delayed the enemy until air reinforcements arrived, earning him India's first Param Vir Chakra.
